newsitem.title: USA: Enstar sells 176,300 shrs of First Union.
newsitem.headline: Enstar sells 176,300 shrs of First Union.

text.p: The Enstar Group Inc said Tuesday it sold 176,300 shares of common stock of First Union Corp in the open market on July 3 and July 7.
Enstar also said that it may sell up to 13,700 more shares of First Union stock in the near future.
The company said net proceeds from the sales will be used to repay about $18.1 million of indebtedness owed to First Union National Bank of Georgia.

The First Union indebtedness, said the company, was incurred by Enstar in October 1996 to make final distributions to creditors under Enstar's bankruptcy plan. Following the sales on July 3 and July 7, Enstar said it holds 677,123 shares of First Union stock.
